items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: My brother went back, the first time he went back he went with Louis. Yeah, 1931.

ctx.x: Since you first went to Chicago then you haven't been back. I don't know if you'd gone back.

I've been back from here to Chicago, but I left there never been back. That's why I said I was supposed to go back with a band, but we never did go. My brother went back, the first time he went back he went with Louis. Yeah, 1931. That's the first only band Louis made up himself. He made that band up himself. But I had never been back. I left there in 1918, never been back.
Well I think that's about the end of this tape here, unless there's something else you wanted to say, but I think that covers your life pretty well.
